units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 13:1">Ex. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. <he>במה אני יי׳</he> of whom am I wearied?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זה הוא הלשון שהיה י׳ וכ׳</he> is this the tongue which was wearing itself out with teaching the Law?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְגֵעִים</he>, <he>יְגֵעִין</he>, <he>יְגֵי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 12:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XII</cite>, beg. <he>י׳ בתורה</he> studying the Law.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:16">Y. Peah I, 15ᵇ</cite> bot. ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:47">Deut. XXXII, 47</cite>) <he>ואם רק הוא מכם למה שאין אתם י׳ בו</he> and if it (the word of the Law) seems to you empty, it is your fault, … because you do not study it carefully; <he>אימתי בשעה שאתם י׳ בו</he> when (is it your life)? When you are busy studying it; Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ; a. fr.
